text:
Gold Price in 1979
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1979, the LBMA gold price rose 119.1% between 1979-01-31 ($234) and 1979-12-28 ($512). The highest sampled price was $512 in December and the lowest was $234 in January. The mean of these observations was $320. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 1979:
Surging inflation, the Iranian Revolution and the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan sent precious metals sharply higher.
